Hello, I’m Steve

I’m the person behind Lawn & Leaf. I’m based in Wisborough Green and look after gardens across West Sussex, keeping them neat, tidy and looking their best all year round.

Whether you’d like regular visits or just a one off tidy, I pay attention to the details and offer a friendly, reliable service you can count on. I can help with lawn mowing and edging, weeding and beds, hedge cutting and shaping, seasonal tidy ups and leaf clearing, and general garden tasks.
